meta.titulo: Clipfine — AI clipping software for agencies
meta.descripcion: Turn every client's podcasts and long videos into captioned vertical clips, schedule them from one calendar and see what works. Built for agencies managing many clients. 15 days free.

datos.descripcion: AI clipping software for agencies: turns each client's podcasts and long videos into captioned vertical clips, schedules them from one calendar and shows what works, client by client.

portada.titulo: Clips, posts and results for every client, in one place.
portada.texto: Upload a client's long video and get its best moments as captioned, vertical clips. Schedule them from one calendar and see what works, for every client your agency manages.

maqueta.alt: Clipfine workspace: a client switcher, a long episode turned into captioned vertical clips, and a weekly posting calendar.

problema.titulo: Your clients want more clips. Your team is already full.
problema.texto: Every new client means more videos to watch, more clips to cut and caption, four platforms to post to and another report to send. Clipfine puts all of it in one place for every client: videos in, clips scheduled, results in view. So you can take on more clients without more payroll.

clientes.texto: Run all your clients from one account. Each one has its own space for episodes, clips, calendar and analytics, plus a Brand Kit with its colors, fonts and logo. Your team works with its role on the clients assigned to it, and nothing gets mixed up.
clientes.alt: List of four clients, each with its own episodes, clips, calendar and analytics

momentos.texto: Upload a podcast or long video: Clipfine transcribes it, finds the moments that stand on their own and builds them as vertical 9:16 clips, captioned and following whoever is speaking. Your team starts with a batch of clips, not a 90-minute timeline.
momentos.alt: A batch of vertical clips with one selected and open in the editor, with trim handles on the timeline

calendario.texto: Schedule each client's clips from one calendar and publish them without downloading and re-uploading. Facebook today; Instagram, TikTok and YouTube are on the way. Meanwhile, every clip downloads as an MP4 ready for any platform.
calendario.alt: Weekly calendar with clips scheduled to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube

analisis.texto: Clipfine reads each client's page history and tells you the best hour, day and format to post, with their reactions and comments. Know what's working and show it to the client.
analisis.alt: Analytics with sample data: posts, reactions, comments and performance by hour

paraQuien.texto: Whether clips are your whole business or an add-on to your production work, Clipfine keeps every client's clips, posts and results in one place.

precios.titulo: Start free. Scale with your client roster.

prueba.para: Try every feature on your first client.

starter.para: For small agencies and first clients.

agencyPro.para: For high-volume teams and large rosters.

custom.texto: 200+ video hours a month, custom setup and guided onboarding on an annual contract. From US$399 a month.

gratis.r: You can try Clipfine free for 15 days with 3 video hours. No card is required. After the trial, plans start at US$15 a month billed annually, or US$19 billed monthly.

horas.p: What counts as a video hour?
horas.r: The length of the videos you upload in the month, across all your clients. Clips and exports are unlimited. Unused hours don't carry over to the next month.

custom.p: What's different on the Custom plan?
custom.r: Agencies processing 200+ video hours a month get a custom setup on an annual contract, plus guided onboarding. Book a demo and we'll walk through your workflow.

redes.p: Which platforms can I post to?
redes.r: Today you post to Facebook from Clipfine's calendar. Instagram, TikTok and YouTube are on the way. Meanwhile, every clip downloads as a vertical MP4, ready for any platform.

clientes.p: Can I manage several clients in one account?
clientes.r: Yes, it's what Clipfine is built for. Each client has its own space for episodes, clips, calendar, analytics and Brand Kit, and every team member works with their own role. One team can run many clients without mixing them up.

opus.p: How is Clipfine different from Opus Clip or Descript?
opus.r: Those tools are built for a single creator. Clipfine is built for agencies with many clients: clips, calendar and analytics sit together, organized by client, with pricing that scales with your roster.

sigue.p: Does the clip follow the person speaking?
sigue.r: Yes, with auto-reframe. It recognizes voices and watches who's moving their lips, so it isn't fooled by someone gesturing. When several people talk, it splits the screen. Every shot can be corrected in the editor.

idioma.p: What language does it work in?
idioma.r: It's built for Spanish-language videos: the transcription, the moments and the captions.

app.r: Yes, for iPhone and Android, with the same account and the same clients as the web.

cierre.titulo: Take on more clients without hiring more editors.
cierre.texto: Start your 15-day free trial today, or book a call and we'll set Clipfine up around your workflow.
